transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

They brought me in after the fair. I climbed up on a tractor during my talk and kept jerking the controls around, trying to show everybody the “new pattern.” Folks were yelling at me to stop, but I just… couldn’t make myself stop.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by the "new pattern"?

The odd numbers in the yield maps and those drone reports—they aren't random. They're coded warnings. Somebody's trying to take the farm out from under me. My wife shows me the lender's regular paperwork, says it's all plain and normal, but I know what I'm seeing.
How much sleep have you been needing over the past few weeks?
Most nights, maybe two or three hours—sometimes I don’t sleep at all. I’ll doze in my chair, then I’m up before the sun feeling charged, ready to work like nothing happened.
Have you ever had a period like this before in your life where you felt this energized and needed very little sleep?
I’m not sure. I can’t really say when it started or whether I’ve had another stretch exactly like this.
Have you ever had a time in the past when you felt unusually down, depressed, or lost interest in your usual activities for weeks at a time?
I don’t know. I can’t think of a time like that, not clearly.
Have you heard any voices or sounds when there was no one around to speak?

Yeah. Out by the north pasture, mostly around dusk, I hear clear voices coming through the irrigation lines. They tell me which rows are poisoned and which ones are blessed. It happens even during weeks when I’m not all fired up.
About how long have you been hearing those voices and noticing the coded warnings?
About 11 months, I’d say. That’s when I first started noticing the voices and the warnings.
How long have you been feeling this charged up and sleeping only two or three hours a night?
It’s been most of the past year, really—about ten months of feeling wound up and barely sleeping.
